title: [Fabric] Separate workspace read and write scopes
summary: Fabric mirroring now uses read-only workspace scopes for browsing operations and requests write permission only for workspace role assignments, with manual setup instructions as fallback.
key_points: Workspace browsing and Open Mirroring database operations now use Workspace.Read.All for read-only access
Add to workspace feature exclusively requests Workspace.ReadWrite.All permission
If token acquisition for write permission fails, users see manual instructions to grant Contributor access in Fabric
Underlying authentication errors are preserved in error details
Custom-app default authentication flow remains unchanged
